title: Dependency cache service down (redis-cache)
description: The shared redis-cache service is unreachable, causing a downstream dependency failure for order and cart services that rely on it. Cache-miss storms amplify latency and error rates on dependent endpoints.
raw_logs: ERROR [order-service] RedisConnectionException: connection refused to redis-cache:6379
ERROR [cart-service] cache read timeout after 5000ms from redis-cache
WARN [order-service] circuit breaker OPEN for redis-cache
